title: Fat & Fine Crab Shack closing in Brunswick as local restaurants face rising costs
text:
Fat & Fine Crab Shack in Brunswick will close at the beginning of the new year due to rising costs, joining a trend of local and national restaurant closures.

The cost of food is steadily going up, paper goods, cleaning supplies, just everything in general price-wise is going up in cost, but the quality of things are going down,” Cross said. Though Fat & Fine Crab Shack has been in business for nine years, it has operated at its current location only since March. Sales were strong through mid-August. “We were profiting, and then after back-to-school time, it kind of died off a good bit, and it’s not really picked back up for any of the downtown businesses, in my opinion,” Cross said. “There are a couple that stay busy, but they’ve been open a lot longer than we have.”’s multiple locations, Bearded Pig’s Jacksonville Beach spot, Ragtime in Atlantic Beach, Plenti, Iguana on Park, and The Happy Grilled Cheese in downtown Jacksonville. Nationally, Wendy’s announced it will close hundreds of restaurants, though specific locations have not been disclosed. Hooters closed about 30 locations across the U.S., including its Southside Jacksonville restaurant.“If you’re out and about and you know something you’re looking for, try to find a local business that sells that. It might cost a couple of dollars more, but you’re helping support a family, not a corporation,” she said. Fat & Fine Crab Shack’s last day of business will be Jan. 2.
